name: Kanban
description: Software-production tasks by status, from internal task files, Linear or GitHub. Start builds from ready cards; move cards to change a task's status.

settings.label: Doing limit
settings.help: The Doing column turns amber when it holds more than this.

settings.label: Task source
settings.help: Where tasks come from. The project's config.json task_system unless you override it here.

settings.label: Linear team
settings.help: The Linear team key, used when the source is Linear and config.json's task_system names no project_ref.

settings.label: GitHub repository or board
settings.help: Used when the source is GitHub and config.json's task_system names no project_ref. A repository shows its issues read-only by open/closed; a Projects v2 board shows its issue items by status, and cards move.

body.query: query($team: String!, $after: String) { issues(first: 100, after: $after, filter: { team: { key: { eq: $team } } }) { nodes { id identifier title priority url state { id name type } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
query($team: String!) { workflowStates(first: 100, filter: { team: { key: { eq: $team } } }) { nodes { id name type position } } }
mutation($issue: String!, $state: String!) { issueUpdate(id: $issue, input: { stateId: $state }) { success } }

query($owner: String!, $repo: String!, $after: String) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $repo) { issues(first: 100, after: $after, orderBy: { field: CREATED_AT, direction: ASC }) { nodes { number title url state stateReason } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

query($owner: String!, $number: Int!, $field: String!, $after: String) { repositoryOwner(login: $owner) { ... on ProjectV2Owner { projectV2(number: $number) { id field(name: $field) { ... on ProjectV2SingleSelectField { id options { id name } } } items(first: 100, after: $after) { nodes { id type content { ... on Issue { number title url repository { name } } } fieldValueByName(name: $field) { ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldSingleSelectValue { name } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } } } }

mutation($project: ID!, $item: ID!, $field: ID!, $option: String!) { updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue(input: { projectId: $project, itemId: $item, fieldId: $field, value: { singleSelectOptionId: $option } }) { projectV2Item { id } } }
